figures.notes: Left panel displays the 9-spectrograph / 10-arm wavelength ladder from 0.1145 to 2.515 um (4.457 spectral octaves), newly adding space-based HST_STIS E140M (0.1145-0.1710 um, R=45,800) and Paranal VLT UVES_RED (0.5655-1.0425 um, R=42k-107k) plus ESPRESSO HR/UHR (R=140k/190k). Right panel plots Gaia DR3 distance vs 8-sigma 10 m CW transmitter power limits across all 200 unique survey stars (including 103 within 10 pc) with D087 HST_STIS FUV (down to 0.0973 W on Proxima Cen) and UVES_RED highlighted cleanly without overlapping labels.

Left panel shows Gate G4_V38 Fiber-B simultaneous calibration regression across all 577 D086 Fiber-B bleed false alarms, confirming 100.0% rejection (577 -> 0 survivors above the fb_pk/fa_med = 1.5 threshold). Right panel compares COMB_V4 vs COMB_V4_1 across the 486 D087 calibration trials: 69.9% recovery on True 6-tooth combs (>=3.8 sigma/tooth) at 0.0% false positive rate on single-line masquerades, stationary ro-vib pseudocombs, and dense molecular forests (vs 98.1% dense-forest FPR for COMB_V4).

Left panel plots the 1,620 Channel T and Channel P injection-recovery curves across HST_STIS, UVES_RED, and ESPRESSO (reaching 100.0% at >=8 sigma_MAD). Right panel shows 100.0% Keplerian K_PLANET de-Doppler recovery vs 0.0% uncompensated T_DIFF (>=6.5 sigma_MAD), 100.0% G4_V38+G5 morphology discrimination across 216 trials, and 100.0% sparse G6_V36 vs sky OH, warm-pixel, and intra-star stationary ghosts across 240 trials.

Left panel verifies barycentric/heliocentric frame kinematics across all 201 exposures (92 ESPRESSO, 55 UVES_RED, 54 HST_STIS LEO), all passing strict pure-stdlib bounds (max Paranal |BERV-stdlib|=0.1632 km/s <= 0.50; max HST LEO=0.1328 km/s <= 8.50). Right panel summarizes all 10 D087 orbital campaigns (#51-#60 cumulative, 3 controls + 7 planet hosts incl. GJ 3138 [UHR+HR] and AU Mic [HST_STIS]) with K_p vs IN_WINDOW delta-v spans and 0 verified ETI.
